values: 劈砍地面掀起一道3格宽的岩浪将敌人击退至战场边缘，然后冲向敌人，发动一次能将敌人击倒的挥砍。
Scarlita slashes the ground and creates a 3-tile-wide Rock Wave to knock enemies back to the battlefield's edge, then charges at targets to launch a mighty strike to knock them down.
斯克嘉莉德朝指定方向劈砍地面，掀起3格宽的一道岩浪，对本方向上的所有敌人造成200% + 20% ATK伤害并将他们击退直至战场边缘，随后斯克嘉莉德冲向他们并大力挥砍，对2格扇形范围内的敌人造成200% + 20% ATK伤害并使他们眩晕1秒。除自身外每有1个存活的友军，本技能的伤害便上升10%。本技能施放期间斯克嘉莉德处于霸体状态。

Scarlita smashes the ground in the specified direction to create a 3-tile-wide Rock Wave, dealing 200% + 20% ATK damage to all enemies in that direction and knocking them back to the edge of the battlefield. Scarlita then charges and strikes, dealing 200% + 20% ATK damage to enemies within the radius of a 2-tile arc and stunning them for 1s. The skill damage is increased by 10% for each surviving ally besides Scarlita. She is unaffected when casting this skill.
劈砍和挥砍的伤害提升至220% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by slash and strike to 220% + 20% ATK.
大力挥砍造成的眩晕时间增加至1.5秒。
除自身外每有1个存活的友军，本技能的伤害便上升12%。
Increases the damage of this skill by 12% for each surviving ally besides Scarlita.
大力挥砍造成的眩晕时间增加至2秒。
斯克嘉莉德在战斗开始后的一段时间内，在半空中积蓄力量，她会在在紧要关头降临战场，造成范围伤害并眩晕敌人。
Scarlita charges power in mid-air for a while after a battle starts, then descends onto the battlefield to deal AoE damage and stuns enemies at critical moments.
战斗开始时，斯克嘉莉德瞬身到队伍后方并登上云端浮在战场上空。处于空中时无敌，每秒恢复40点能量并直至战斗结束提升2%攻击力。当战斗进行了15秒或者除斯克嘉莉德外存活的非召唤物友军数量小于等于2名时，斯克嘉莉德降临至最靠前的敌人附近。降临的同时斯克嘉莉德锤击地面，对周围2格内的敌人造成200% + 20% ATK的伤害，击飞他们，并使他们眩晕4秒。

When a battle starts, Scarlita blinks to the backline, ascends to the sky, and hovers above the battlefield. While in the air, she is invincible, recovering 40 Energy per second, and increasing 2% ATK till the battle ends. 15s into the battle or when there are 2 or fewer surviving non-summoned allies besides her, Scarlita descends near the frontmost enemy. She smashes the ground upon landing, dealing 200% + 20% ATK damage to the enemies within 2 tiles and knocking them into the air, stunning them for 4s.
斯克嘉莉德如果在战斗进行了15秒后才降临战场，她额外恢复150点能量。
Scarlita recovers an extra 150 Energy if she descends after 15s into the battle.
斯克嘉莉德如果在战斗进行了15秒后才降临战场，她额外提升15%攻击力，直至战斗结束。
Scarlita gains an extra 15% ATK boost till the end of battle if she descends after 15s into a battle.
斯克嘉莉德浮空时可以为最虚弱的友军添加护盾，斯克嘉莉德在降临战场后可以挥动战斧造成范围伤害。
Grants the weakest allied hero shield when hovering mid-air and deals AoE damage with the axe upon landing.

处于空中时，斯克嘉莉德每次对最虚弱的非召唤物友军发动1次护佑，使目标获得持续3秒的护盾，护盾值为斯克嘉莉德15% HP。
降临战场后，斯克嘉莉德每次挥动战斧，对2格扇形范围内的敌人造成135% + 10% ATK的伤害，击退并击倒他们。除自身外每有1个存活的非召唤物友军，本技能的伤害便上升10%。

Scarlita sends the weakest non-summoned ally a blessing while in the air, granting them a shield equal to 15% HP of Scarlita's max HP for 3s.
Every time Scarlita wields her axe after descending on the battlefield, she deals 135% + 10% ATK damage to the enemies within a 2-tile arc and knocks them down. This skill damage increases by 10% for each surviving non-summoned ally besides herself.
护盾值提升至斯克嘉莉德18% HP。
Increases the shield value to 18% HP of Scarlita.
护盾值提升至斯克嘉莉德20% HP。
Increases the shield value to 20% HP of Scarlita.
除自身外每有1个存活的非召唤物友军，本技能的伤害便上升12%。
Increases the damage of this skill by 12% for each surviving non-summoned ally other than Scarlita.
每释放一次护佑，落地后提升自身终结。
Scarlita gains Execution for each blessing sent before she lands from the air.
处于空中时每释放一次护佑，在落地后提升4点终结。
Scarlita increases Execution by 4 for each blessing she sends while in the air.
处于空中时每释放一次护佑，在落地后提升5点终结。
Scarlita increases Execution by 5 for each blessing she sends while in the air.
处于空中时每释放一次护佑，在落地后提升6点终结。
Scarlita increases Execution by 6 for each blessing she sends while in the air.
在存活的己方英雄数目足够多的情况下，斯克嘉莉德的技能会造成真实伤害。
Deals true damage when there are enough surviving allied heroes.
如果除斯克嘉莉德外有至少4个存活的非召唤物友军，斯克嘉莉德的各个技能会造成真实伤害。
Scarlita deals true damage if there are at least 4 surviving non-summoned allies other than herself on the battlefield.
如果除斯克嘉莉德外有至少3个存活的非召唤物友军，斯克嘉莉德的各个技能会造成真实伤害。
Scarlita deals true damage if there are at least 3 surviving non-summoned allies other than herself on the battlefield.
斯克嘉莉德的各个技能会将当前生命值低于她180% ATK且生命值百分比低于20%的非首领敌人击出场外，以此法击出场外的敌人无法回到战场，视作被击败。

Scarlita's skills knock the non-boss enemies with HP lower than 180% ATK and HP ratio below 20% out of the battlefield. The enemy sent out the combat this way cannot return and is considered defeated.
斯克嘉莉德的各个技能会将当前生命值低于她180% ATK且生命值百分比低于25%的非首领敌人击出场外，以此法击出场外的敌人无法回到战场，视作被击败。

Scarlita's skills knock the non-boss enemies with HP lower than 180% ATK and HP ratio below 25% out of the battlefield. The enemy sent out the combat this way cannot return and is considered defeated.
技能“天武英灵”在护佑友军的同时，还会使这名友军提升护甲与魔抗。
Scarlita increases an allied hero's Phys DEF and Magic DEF when using Valkyrie Spirit to protect them.
技能“天武英灵”在护佑友军的同时，还会使这名友军提升护甲与魔抗，提升量等同于斯克嘉莉德护甲与魔抗的50%。
Scarlita increases an allied hero's Phys DEF and Magic DEF when using Valkyrie Spirit to protect them, with the amount equal to 50% of Scarlita's own Phys DEF and Magic DEF.
技能“天影神裁”期间，若一名友军生命值比例低于20%，立即为其施加一个可抵御120% HP伤害的护盾，持续10秒，该效果每场战斗至多触发一次。若降临战场时此效果仍未触发，则降临时锤击伤害范围扩大至全场，并提升75%伤害。

If an ally's HP ratio drops below 20% while Scarlita is in the air during Sanctified Verdict, she instantly grants them a shield that blocks 120% HP damage for 10s. This effect can trigger once per battle. If the shield is not activated by the time Scarlita descends from midair, Sanctified Verdict's ground smash will affect the entire battlefield and deals 75% more damage.
